_comment: Cockpit action cards. Superboard ships exactly one: keeping itself current is a job every workspace has, so the Cockpit is never an empty shell. Everything else is personal — the Set up your Cockpit card proposes 2–4 actions from the user's real work, and each accepted card becomes a one-click agent mission here.

actions.label: Check for updates
actions.prompt: Check for updates: load the skill in `.claude/skills/superboard-update/SKILL.md` and follow it. Compare the installed Superboard package with the latest release on PyPI, and any installed catalogue skills with their catalogue. Clicking this card is my order to install: first make sure this workspace is a git repository and commit the current state (initialise it if needed, no need to ask), then update and verify that the board still starts and loads. If I changed files locally, merge the update with my changes yourself; ask me only if a conflict is genuinely unresolvable. Never write to actions.json, rituals.json, board.config.json, inbox/board.md or the thread files. If everything is current, say so in one line and stop. Otherwise end with a short, friendly note on what is new for me.
